industry.headline: Meta's $18B child-safety settlement mandates teen time limits, sparks age-verification backlash
industry.summary: Meta's up-to-$17.1B multistate settlement requires stricter under-13 enforcement and a two-hour daily cap plus nighttime/school-hour restrictions for 13-17 year olds, but critics warn the new mandated age-verification requirements raise privacy and free-speech concerns — a tension NOMO can navigate by staying reward-based rather than surveillance-based.

industry.headline: Meta settlement ties further teen time-limit rollbacks to TikTok and YouTube adopting matching controls
industry.summary: Meta's deal sets a default 2-hour/day limit for under-18s plus a midnight-6am block and school-hours notification muting, with Meta pledging to cut the limit to 1 hour and expand the blackout to 10pm-7am if TikTok and YouTube adopt the same measures — an explicit 'industry standard' push that validates NOMO's core screen-time-reduction thesis while also risking reduced differentiation as platforms build the feature natively.

industry.headline: New Mexico's separate $567M abatement order shows Meta settlements stacking, not resolving, state exposure
industry.summary: Alongside the multistate deal, a New Mexico judge separately ordered Meta to pay $567M into a child-safety abatement fund, signaling that state-level settlement funds — often earmarked for youth mental-health/screen-time programs — are proliferating and could become a funding channel for school-based tools like NOMO.

industry.headline: TikTok and ByteDance settle DOJ/FTC COPPA suit for $400M
industry.summary: TikTok will pay $300M immediately (plus $100M contingent) in one of the largest-ever COPPA recoveries, resolving claims it let under-13s create accounts and ignored parental deletion requests — sustained federal scrutiny of minors' data that strengthens NOMO's privacy-safe, non-surveillance positioning.

industry.headline: LAUSD begins enforcing new screen-time tracking for the 2026-27 school year
industry.summary: The nation's second-largest school district is now logging device usage on school-issued devices for administrators (without auto-shutoff) — validating district demand for tools that measure and reward reduced use, directly adjacent to NOMO's school partnership pitch.

industry.headline: Appeals court rules Section 230 doesn't shield Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap from addictive-design suits
industry.summary: A federal appeals court cleared the way for 3,000+ pending lawsuits (an MDL of 3,137 actions) alleging platforms were designed to be addictive to kids, weakening the Section 230 shield and strengthening the case schools can make for adopting counter-programming tools like NOMO as a liability-mitigation strategy.

industry.headline: More than two dozen countries now enacting or weighing under-16 social media bans, including Brazil
industry.summary: Since Australia's ban, momentum has spread to Europe and developing nations including Indonesia, Vietnam, and Brazil — NOMO's first and most established market — while several US states (e.g., California) are also getting serious about restrictions, reinforcing that NOMO's reward model aligns with, not against, emerging regulation in its priority regions.

industry.headline: UK PM Starmer says 'no option off the table' as Lords pass age-assurance amendments
industry.summary: Starmer signaled openness to Australia-style bans while the House of Lords passed amendments requiring under-16 age assurance and VPN verification within 12 months — a favorable regulatory tailwind directly relevant to NOMO's UK pilot and CEO Leonardo's policy engagement.
